process_area.title: Waiver of Lien, Progress Billing Reconciliation & Account Hold Management

value_stream.name: B2B Project Financing, Escrow Account Orchestration & Lien Release

fields.Trigger: Material goods delivery receipt verification (W5209); billing invoice release
fields.Volume: ~1,500–2,000 conditional waivers generated monthly (the ~100–120/month are the unconditional settlement counterparts per W5218)

workflows.name: Conditional Progress Waiver of Lien Issuance (upon Delivery)

Automation Opportunity: - Automatic system generation of conditional waivers linked to invoice output.
Controls: - CTL-775 (ensure controlled execution — Waiver of Lien, Progress Billing Reconciliation & Account Hold Management (PA-181.3).)
- CTL-775: Document template legal-locked; waiver output verified by AR supervisor.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unconditional release issued prematurely**: Releasing lien rights before payment clears, leaving company unsecured; mitigated by strict system validation blocking unconditional prints before payment application.
System Touchpoints: - ERP AR invoicing (VS-16), Document control database (VS-88).

steps.activity: Retrieve matching project code, invoice number, and delivery receipt weights/details.
Draft the Conditional Progress Waiver of Lien (specifying that BuildRight waives lien rights on delivered materials conditional upon actual payment clearance).
File and print copy of the conditional waiver; attach to the Escrow Draw Request folder (W5211).
Record waiver status as 'Conditional-Pending Payment' in ERP project registry.

workflows.name: Unconditional Progress Waiver of Lien Issuance (upon Fund Settlement)

Automation Opportunity: - Automatic trigger generating draft unconditional waiver upon invoice balance matching zero.
Controls: - CTL-775 (ensure controlled execution — Waiver of Lien, Progress Billing Reconciliation & Account Hold Management (PA-181.3).)
- CTL-775: Notarized waiver copies kept in legal archives; sign-off authorized only upon cleared cash validation.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Bounced payment clearing delay**: Bank wire reversed due to compliance holds after waiver release; mitigated by waiting 3 business days for payment confirmation before releasing unconditional notary.
System Touchpoints: - ERP AR cash ledger (VS-16), Legal document tracking (VS-100), notary registry.

steps.activity: Verify payment clearance: check cash application status in ERP showing invoices cleared (W5213).
Draft Unconditional Progress Waiver of Lien referencing the cleared invoice IDs, payment references, and values.
Secure signature from the B2B Credit Manager or Legal Operations Officer.
Send original notarized Unconditional Waiver of Lien to the developer; update status as 'Settled-Unconditional' in ERP.

workflows.name: Project Material Return, Credit Note & Reconciliation with Escrow draws

Automation Opportunity: - System-generated credit matching notifications to bank agent email.
Controls: - CTL-775 (ensure controlled execution — Waiver of Lien, Progress Billing Reconciliation & Account Hold Management (PA-181.3).)
- CTL-775: Credit notes above PHP 100K require Controller approval; physical goods receipt verified before posting.
Cross-references: - links to VS-32 (returns), VS-08 (POS), VS-04 (DC ops)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Double counting / Rejection fraud**: Billed returns not updated at bank escrow, causing audit mismatches; mitigated by mandatory bank notifications for all project credit notes.
System Touchpoints: - ERP Returns module (VS-32), POS/Receiving ledger (VS-08), B2B AR ledger.

workflows.name: Project Escrow Delay Credit-Hold Hold-and-Release Execution

Automation Opportunity: - ERP automatic credit hold block upon term expiry.
Controls: - CTL-775 (ensure controlled execution — Waiver of Lien, Progress Billing Reconciliation & Account Hold Management (PA-181.3).)
- CTL-775: Hold overrides require CFO or B2B VP approval; audit logs of credit overrides reviewed monthly.
Cross-references: - links to VS-16 (O2C), VS-06 (logistics), VS-04 (DC ops)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Construction site blockade**: Stranding project mid-phase causing subcontractor claims; mitigated by providing 5-day warning period to developers before executing active holds.
System Touchpoints: - ERP Credit hold screen (VS-16), transport dispatch scheduler (VS-06), CRM notification.

steps.activity: Identify delinquent project accounts: check ERP aging reports for payments delayed past escrow terms (e.g. over 60 days).
Issue formal payment warning: send credit hold notice to the developer and general contractor.
Execute ERP Credit Hold: lock the project code in ERP to prevent shipping orders or releasing reserved stocks.
Negotiate payment release or release hold manually in ERP upon receiving bank verification of pending transfer.

fields.Trigger: General contractor subcontracting specialized trade works; developer requesting direct payments to sub-contractors

Controls: - CTL-775 (ensure controlled execution — Waiver of Lien, Progress Billing Reconciliation & Account Hold Management (PA-181.3).)
- CTL-775: Agreement signed by Legal Counsel and B2B Credit Manager; direct payments verified against project escrow logs.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Subcontractor liability transfer**: BuildRight losing recourse against developer for unpaid materials; mitigated by including absolute developer guarantee clauses in agreements.
System Touchpoints: - Legal contract archives (VS-100), ERP billing ledger (VS-16), accounts payable database.

steps.activity: Review developer request for direct billing: verify subcontractor credentials and project details.
Draft Tripartite Payment Agreement: define direct payment terms, developer guarantee of liability, and subcontractor delivery verification protocols.
Execute agreement: configure ERP billing rules to route invoices directly to developer while booking liabilities to subcontractor project codes.
Audit monthly payments: match direct developer escrow draw releases to subcontractor invoices.

fields.Participants: Stock Clerk, B2B Account Manager, S&OP team (VS-127)
fields.Trigger: Supply chain pre-positioning plan (W5203) activation; materials staged at DC

workflows.name: Project-Restricted Inventory Allocation Hold & Release Control

Automation Opportunity: - System-automated reservation locking matching project timeline forecasts.
Controls: - CTL-775 (ensure controlled execution — Waiver of Lien, Progress Billing Reconciliation & Account Hold Management (PA-181.3).)
- CTL-775: Reservation logs reviewed weekly by DC controller; stock aging monitored.
Cross-references: - links to VS-04 (DC ops), VS-02 (supply planning), VS-60 (order routing), VS-127 (S&OP)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Inventory hoarding / DC space loss**: Project delayed, locking up warehouse capacity for months; mitigated by setting 30-day auto-release limits on project holds unless extended by Controller.
System Touchpoints: - WMS reservation module (VS-04), Order routing engine (VS-60), ERP S&OP (VS-127).

steps.activity: Staging materials: move project-specific building materials (e.g. custom steel sections, paint color batches) to project staging zone.
Apply system reservation lock in WMS: tag inventory as 'Project-Restricted - Mapped to Developer Code X'.
Configure WMS restriction rules: prevent stock from being picked for retail stores or standard B2C sales.
Release inventory lock: auto-release stock upon receiving matched project delivery dispatch manifest (VS-60).

workflows.name: Progressive Billing Audit, Revenue Leakage Prevention & Internal Control Review

Automation Opportunity: - Automated data mining check sheets flagging billing discrepancies.
Controls: - CTL-775 (ensure controlled execution — Waiver of Lien, Progress Billing Reconciliation & Account Hold Management (PA-181.3).)
- CTL-775: Audit report presented to Audit Committee; remediation targets monitored quarterly.
Cross-references: - links to VS-21 (internal audit), VS-118 (revenue assurance), VS-100 (legal)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Revenue leakage**: Unbilled material deliveries or uncollected retainage money due to tracking failures; mitigated by automatic monthly reconciliation checks.
System Touchpoints: - Audit dashboard (VS-21), Revenue assurance database (VS-118), GL AR ledger.

workflows.name: Project Account Financial Close, Final Waiver of Lien & Release of Escrow

Controls: - CTL-775 (ensure controlled execution — Waiver of Lien, Progress Billing Reconciliation & Account Hold Management (PA-181.3).)
- CTL-775: Project account audited and closed by Corporate Controller; signed final releases filed in corporate archives (VS-88).
Cross-references: - links to VS-17.1 (GL close), VS-100 (legal), VS-88 (document control)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unreleased escrow**: Bank holding final release due to developer dispute with other vendors; mitigated by negotiating direct bank release to BuildRight for verified material invoices.
System Touchpoints: - ERP GL account close (VS-17.1), Legal records database (VS-100), B2B CRM.
